multi-screens.name: Multi Screens 1.10.3
multi-screens.body:
## 1.10.3 — 18 November 2026

The Page theme and Network lists in the SCAFFApps colours.

### Downloads

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `Multi-Screens-Setup-1.10.3.exe` | 71.1 MB | `117E7EB9784BF14D8B676C013852F487D8E27A1F2A7224B71291203C3537959A` |
| `Multi-Screens-Handbook-1.10.3.pdf` | 4.6 MB | `354B1F658C65B9BA7D6EB09E8453AF996C60170C9332FD317E0AA8FF5CBBFA76` |

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Changed

- **The Page theme and Network lists** open in the SCAFFApps colours: a card in the window's own colours, the chosen item in gold (purple in the light appearance) with a tick, the one under the pointer lit in grey, as in every SCAFFApps menu. It was the list Windows draws, in its own blue with a grey frame. The arrow keys, Enter and Esc work as before, and nothing beside the list moves. Smart Snap 1.3.1 has the same lists, from the same code.
- **The handbook**, `Multi-Screens-Handbook-1.10.3.pdf`: 1.10.2's pages and pictures, with the new version.

### Updating from 1.10.2 or earlier

- Settings > Updates > **Update now**, or **Update** in the SCAFFApps Suite.

### Tested

- The packaged program in a test profile: both lists are the new ones, as wide and as high as before; choosing Slow 4G sets the network and saves it, and after a restart the Network list shows Slow 4G again.
- The window in Edge: both lists open in the dark and the light appearance, their words whole.
- The SCAFFApps design-language check passes, the new shared files included. Microsoft Defender finds nothing in the installer.

### Not tested

- This installer over 1.10.2.

smart-snap.name: Smart Snap 1.3.2
smart-snap.body:
## 1.3.2 — 18 November 2026

An area snap freezes the screen the moment you press the key, as Windows' Snipping Tool does: an open menu and the item lit under the mouse stay in the snap.

### Downloads

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `Smart-Snap-Setup-1.3.2.exe` | 71.1 MB | `EECDE2E2670C305EDAE4F2C060C2933FED8BCE8739C5BDCAB815B6F20E526558` |
| `Smart-Snap-Handbook-1.3.2.pdf` | 4.3 MB | `EAEC8F3FBC78BC213C84EB5740AA98C393CF40C9FB20259BB499DAEB38C96F52` |

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Changed

- **Area snaps freeze the screen first.** Ctrl + Alt + S or PrtScn takes the picture of the screen at once, before anything of Smart Snap's covers it, and you choose the area on that picture. Since 1.1.3 the area was chosen on the live screen and the picture taken when you let go; by then the dimmed screen had taken the mouse from the program under it, which put out the item lit under the mouse and could close an open menu, so they were missing from the snap.
- **The frozen screen is the screen, pixel for pixel.** No zoom as it appears, no flash, and nothing blurred or moved: it looks as if the screen had simply stopped, then dims. (The frozen screen after a Delay used to be a slightly stretched JPEG copy that zoomed in.)
- **Pictures in about 50 ms.** Area, window and full-screen snaps take their picture with Windows' own copy of the screen, where Smart Snap's earlier way took about half a second. The dimmed screen shows about 0.4 s after the key; the screen stays as it is until then.
- **The handbook**, `Smart-Snap-Handbook-1.3.2.pdf`: Taking a snap says the screen freezes, and when to use PrtScn or a Delay for a menu.

### Updating from 1.3.1 or earlier

- Settings > Updates > **Update now**, or **Update** in the SCAFFApps Suite.

### Tested

- From the source in a test profile, over a full-screen test pattern that changed to a second pattern 150 ms after the snap was asked for: four area snaps, each dragged from code, were exactly the size dragged (900 × 600 pixels at 150%), showed the first pattern only and kept their typed comment; a full-screen snap showed the first pattern (1.3.1, the same test: the second); window snaps showed the first pattern.
- The frozen screen against the real one over a page of small coloured text, six times, grabbed eight times in the first half second and again after a second: every grab identical to the real screen, pixel for pixel. (1.3.1: a zoom for about 0.2 s, then half the pixels different, the picture stretched by up to 2 pixels.)
- Recording a video: the area is chosen on the live screen as before, the bar shows, Cancel closes it, and an area snap straight after is exact.
- The installer over 1.3.1 on the developer's laptop (2560 × 1600 at 150%), as an update: 1.3.2 starts with the new screen copy.

### Not tested

- Several displays, and displays at different scales.
- A program's own menu with a real mouse and keyboard (the test changes the screen from code instead).

instant-share.name: Instant Share 1.3.6
instant-share.body:
## 1.3.6 — 16 November 2026

The tray icon's menu in the SCAFFApps style, the same as Smart Snap's and the SCAFFApps Suite's.

### Downloads

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `Instant-Share-Setup-1.3.6.exe` | 13.8 MB | `80C82D240274DE81253970FB8C5C45AAC93AA8465B3DFC1C521475E22C0A8CB8` |
| `Instant-Share-1.3.6.apk` | 70 KB | `F721D016F621CD48350DCE9231927283232D90AD802F2A3730A9917D7B59EE0F` |
| `instantshare.py` | 169 KB | `1B92FF7C493D3DF5868015D41DCE06BD1024C237D9A8002567CA61C5FDE4B3C9` |
| `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt` | 143 KB | `DF09683971A8AC3754A73BA27E0A40FB2F14535DB0C554ADA30A2C62E85E6A07` |
| `Instant-Share-Handbook-1.3.6.pdf` | 3.2 MB | `18C957EA76AC7904D24ED0B4501B5245784EDCE598996AFF4B61F144832129BE` |

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11, and Android 10 and newer. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Changed

- **The tray icon's menu** is now the menu every SCAFFApps app has: taller rows, the whole row lit under the pointer, rounded corners, dark or light as Windows is. The same items as before: Open Instant Share, Add a device…, Start with Windows, Change setup… and Quit Instant Share. Instant Share draws it itself, still without any third-party code.
- **No empty gap on the left**: the menu makes room for the tick only while **Start with Windows** is ticked.
- **The handbook**, `Instant-Share-Handbook-1.3.6.pdf`: 1.3.4's pages and pictures, with the new version.

(1.3.5 was made but not published: 1.3.6 is the same with the gap gone.)

### Updating

- **Windows, from 1.3.0 to 1.3.4:** Settings > Updates > **Update now**, or **Update** in the SCAFFApps Suite.
- **Android:** nothing changed in the app but its version number; **Update now** in the app installs it, or keep 1.3.4.

### Tested

- From the source code in a test profile: the tray icon right-clicked the way Windows tells it, the menu drawn without the tick's room, **Start with Windows** ticked through it (into a test entry, not the real list) and the menu then drawn with it, Esc closes it, **Quit Instant Share** ends the program.
- The menu next to Smart Snap's, both at 150 %, with an item ticked: the same size to the pixel (259 × 273 against Electron's 258 × 273), the same rows, colours, tick, text and hover, in the dark and the light appearance. Windows 11 gives it a slightly larger shadow.
- Installed over 1.3.5 on a working computer the way the updates do it (silently, with Windows' permission): Windows lists 1.3.6, Instant Share opened again, and its tray menu opens without the gap and closes with Esc.
- Microsoft Defender finds nothing in the installer or the Android app.

scaffapps-suite.name: SCAFFApps Suite 1.0.5
scaffapps-suite.body:
## 1.0.5 — 18 November 2026

An app's card no longer shakes while it updates.

### Downloads

| File | Size | SHA-256 |
|---|---|---|
| `SCAFFApps-Suite-Setup-1.0.5.exe` | 71.1 MB | `7858E5582898090C5E4FCE242F66C403A2CBC21A924ECAF6934C64C57B545765` |
| `SCAFFApps-Suite-Handbook-1.0.5.pdf` | 4.1 MB | `12EDD85252E7F6E3376DFD813863BF720F51D2C4F69C20FB0852816B6FCFA1A0` |

For 64-bit Windows 10 and 11. Not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first run.

### Fixed

- **An app's card no longer shakes while the app updates.** The Suite drew its whole window again on every report of the download, several a second, and each time the card under the pointer began its small rise again, so it shook; the progress bar's stripes and the spinner jumped back as well. Now a part of the window is drawn again only when it has changed, and the progress bar and its numbers move in place.

### Changed

- **The handbook**, `SCAFFApps-Suite-Handbook-1.0.5.pdf`: 1.0.4's pages and pictures, with the new version.

### Updating from 1.0.4

- **Update** on the Updates page, or the Suite's card in the sidebar. Windows asks for permission; the Suite closes, is updated and opens again.

### Tested

- The Suite's window in Edge, with stand-ins for the rest of the Suite, the pointer resting on Smart Snap's card while it downloads (40 progress reports, 60 ms apart): with 1.0.4's code the card was drawn anew on every report and moved between four heights, 1.2 pixels apart; with this version it is the same card throughout and does not move, while the bar goes from 0 to 70 % and the numbers count up to 71.1 MB of 71.1 MB.
- The SCAFFApps design-language check passes. Microsoft Defender finds nothing in the installer.

### Not tested

- The packaged Suite was not started: a test copy would set itself to start with Windows, in place of the Suite installed on the computer. This installer over 1.0.4, and a real update watched through it.
